METR 的研究以人类专家完成任务所需的时间衡量难度，报告 50% 成功率对应的: METR measures task difficulty by the time human experts need to complete it. During the study period, the task horizon at a 50% success rate doubled approximately every seven months.
这是任务的人类用时，无法直接换算成 Agent 连续运行时长、人均管理数量或可靠: This measures human task time. It cannot be directly converted into continuous agent runtime, agents managed per person or reliable delivery capacity.

三个现场实验涵盖 4,867 名开发者；合并估计使用 AI 助手后完成任务数提高: Three field experiments covered 4,867 developers. The pooled estimate found 26.08% more completed tasks with AI assistants, with a standard error of 10.3%.
研究主要考察代码助手；任务数量增长不能直接转成人均价值增长，也没有测量多 Age: The research primarily examines coding assistants. More tasks do not directly imply greater value per person, and the studies did not measure multi-agent benefits.
感觉更快与实际更快会分离: Feeling faster can diverge from being faster
16 名熟悉大型开源项目的开发者处理 246 个真实任务；允许使用当时的 AI: 16 developers familiar with large open-source projects worked on 246 real tasks. Access to the AI tools available at the time increased completion time by 19%.
这是特定时段、人员和代码库上的结果，不能外推到当前全部开发任务；审核与纠错应纳入: These results concern specific people, repositories and a particular period. They cannot be generalized to all current development tasks. Review and correction belong in human effort.

METR 指出并发使用 Agent、等待期间处理其他任务，以及参与者和任务选择偏: METR notes that concurrent agent use, doing other work while waiting, and participant and task selection bias make per-task duration a poor proxy for actual productivity.
这项更新揭示测量限制，无法据此推断一个人能管理多少 Agent，也不能把新实验点: This update exposes measurement limitations. It does not establish how many agents one person can manage, nor should new experimental point estimates be treated as certain productivity gains.
